scope: Pre-existing local R22 design/status/research documents, V3.2 completed case_audit and matrix manifest, R22 output case paths, text manifests, and compact archive filenames. The new seed_registry_audit.json and r22_v4_size_pilot_draft_20261123.json proposal files are excluded from the historical-collision scan because they intentionally record the proposed seed. This is not a claim that every external archive, remote artifact, Git object, or non-R22 project seed registry was exhaustively examined.

v4_target_confirmatory.prior_reservation: V3.2 design reserves this range for confirmatory work.
v4_target_confirmatory.completed_v3_2_screening_observation: The local V3.2 case_audit contains 288 completed cases and 12 unique seeds, 1932001-1932012; no completed V3.2 case uses this confirmatory range.
v4_target_confirmatory.pilot_eligibility: Do not use for a size pilot; preserve the range for the confirmatory design.

v4_h0_candidate.prior_independent_h0_range: V3.2 used 1935001-1935030 for its completed independent H0 matrix; the V4 candidate range is disjoint.

size_pilot_candidate.selection_rule: Use one seed outside the V4 target confirmatory and H0 ranges, outside the completed V3.2 screening/H0 cohorts, and absent from local R22 case IDs/manifests. Re-run the full project seed registry check before freeze.

limitations: The candidate pilot seed is clear within the audited local R22 scope, not globally certified across every non-R22 dataset or external archive.
The proposed seed is now intentionally recorded in this audit and the draft pilot configuration; those proposal records are not evidence of a prior execution.
Seed equality is checked through case identity/path and manifest fields; arbitrary CSV numeric payloads are not treated as seed identities.
No candidate seed was executed or added to a confirmatory cohort by this audit.
